name: Westfield Santa Anita
description: Westfield Santa Anita is a premier enclosed regional shopping mall in Arcadia, California, featuring over 160 stores and restaurants including Nordstrom, Macy's, and JCPenney as anchor tenants. The center offers an upscale shopping experience with a diverse mix of national retailers, specialty boutiques, and a popular dining terrace. Located at the historic Santa Anita Race Track site, the mall serves as the primary retail destination for the San Gabriel Valley.
demographics: Affluent suburban families in the San Gabriel Valley with high Asian-American population, serving the Arcadia, Pasadena, and greater Los Angeles area with strong purchasing power and interest in fashion and dining.
summary: A premier San Gabriel Valley shopping destination featuring 160+ stores with department store anchors and diverse dining options in an enclosed mall setting.
